theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with Archetype 7 (Electric/Neon) for a Cozy yet Vibrant aesthetic

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large stats, and media titles.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, tags, and small metadata.

colors.philosophy: CSS variables define the entire palette. Default theme 'Tokyo Twilight' uses deep moody backgrounds with glowing pastel/neon accents to mimic late-night anime watching.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Asymmetric grids. Sidebar navigation.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (`w-64` or `w-72`) on desktop, hidden on mobile behind a hamburger menu. Must contain navigation links, user profile snippet, and Hanabi extension connection status.
layout_and_spacing.main_content: Margin-left to accommodate sidebar on desktop. Wrap inside a `p-6 md:p-12` container for breathing room.

grids.media_gallery: grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-6
grids.stats_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 (Mode B 'Control Room' grid rules applied for sleek stats)

layout_and_spacing.containers: All surfaces must have nested radii. If card is `rounded-xl`, internal image is `rounded-lg`. Elements that have backgrounds must have internal padding (`p-4` or `p-6`).

icons.instruction: Use Lucide icons for all UI elements. NO EMOJIS for UI functionality.

media_card.design: Flat, rectangular poster aspect ratio (2:3). Image takes up 100% of card. Title and episode info appear as an overlay on hover using a dark gradient scrim at the bottom (`bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent`). Badge at top-right for rating or status.
media_card.interaction: Hover: Slight scale up (`hover:scale-105`), smooth transition (`transition-transform duration-300`). Image brightens.

hanabi_inbox.design: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80`). 1px inner border. Should slide in or float to notify the user of detected media.
hanabi_inbox.glow: Use a subtle box-shadow utilizing the primary color variable to signify it's active.

theme_picker.design: Settings page should show a bento grid of theme options. Each option is a small card previewing the primary, secondary, and background colors. Selected theme gets a `ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background`.

status_badge.design: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), small font (`text-xs uppercase tracking-wider`). Background is a 10% opacity tint of the status color, text is the solid status color.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion for soft fade and slight slide-up (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}`) on route changes or tab switching.
motion_and_interactions.staggered_lists: Media gallery items must use stagger reveals. Do not just load 20 cards at once; let them cascade in.
motion_and_interactions.theme_transition: Apply `transition-colors duration-500` to the `body` tag so switching themes is a fluid, magical experience, not an abrupt flash.

testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Text over posters must have sufficient text-shadow or a gradient overlay underneath to pass APCA contrast checks.

media_assets.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these precise URLs for mock data, backgrounds, and empty states. DO NOT use generic placeholder services.

backgrounds.description: Narrow city alley at night - Good for Tokyo Twilight theme background
Wet cyberpunk street - Good for auth page or cyberpunk theme
Anime themed interior - Good for Matcha/Cozy theme

implementation_checklist: 1. Setup font imports for Cabinet Grotesk and Figtree in index.css
2. Setup CSS variables in index.css for the themes. Use a class-based approach (e.g., .theme-sakura, .theme-dracula) on the html/body tag.
3. Implement the Layout with Sidebar and main content area.
4. Build the Media Card component with hover overlays.
5. Build the Theme Picker bento grid.
7. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
